text: The local prefix protocol is removed: decodeResponse now uses a private ResponseFailure ADT, so diagnostics cannot be reclassified by string prefix. SshFailureClassificationSuite remains 7/7 green. The remaining acceptance item changes AgentBody response payloads so typed failure kind crosses the wire; that belongs to P6f.12's versioned codec decision, so this bead now depends on P6f.12 rather than pretending the wire is fixed.
